item.name: Diffusal Blade

effects.title: Inhibit
effects.text: Targets an enemy, slowing it for 4 seconds.

effects.title: Manabreak
effects.text:
Each attack burns 40 mana from the target, and deals 1 physical damage per burned mana. 

Illusions do not burn mana.

notes: Does not stack with other diffusal blades.
item.lore: An enchanted blade that allows the user to cut straight into the enemy's soul.
